note: Additive to quest-city-platform-openapi-v1_2.yaml through v1_6.yaml, v1_8.yaml through v1_11.yaml, all unmodified and independently tracked (v1_7.yaml was never vendored, same as noted in every prior provenance file). Formalizes Tranche D Account/Tenant Convergence: create/list/read a ConvergenceRequest, preview with integrated identity verification (PLATFORM_ADMIN-only), unified approve/reject, per-unit transactional execute, rollback-review (ACCEPT_PARTIAL/RETRY_REMAINING, never a total automatic rollback), tenant context switching (GET /me/tenant-memberships, POST /staff-auth/session/switch-tenant), and content ownership promotion scoped to an approved convergence (POST /content/{id}/promote). 11-state closed state machine. No new staff role -- reuses INDEPENDENT_EDUCATOR/SCHOOL_ADMIN/PLATFORM_ADMIN exactly as already implemented for Tranche A/B/C. Licensing (operation 4 of the conceptual workflow) is explicitly out of scope of this file and of this vendoring -- no endpoint, no schema.
